core_obligations: With respect to the formal and actual fundamental matrix solutions, describe explicitly the connected component of the identity of the local differential Galois group at the origin of the system (eq) in every arithmetic case of the parameter alpha: alpha a natural number, alpha a non-positive integer, alpha rational but not an integer, and the remaining cases, displaying the four by four matrix groups that occur.
proof_roadmap: Case alpha in N: the formal monodromy is the identity, the Stokes matrix St_pi vanishes, and the group generated by the exponential torus and St_0 is displayed. Case alpha in Z_{<=0}: replace St_pi for St_0. Case alpha rational non-integral: the formal Galois group is disconnected but its identity component is the torus, and G^0 is generated by the torus and both Stokes matrices; display the resulting group. The remaining cases: repeat the same analysis of the Stokes structure.
